name_zh: 斯里兰卡·西丽玛沃·班达拉奈克：僧伽罗佛教社会主义与女性总理
name_en: Sri Lanka Sirimavo Bandaranaike: Sinhala Buddhism Socialism & Woman Prime Minister
description_zh: 西丽玛沃·班达拉奈克 (1916-2000) 世界首位女总理 (1960-1965, 1970-1977, 1994-2000)，丈夫遇刺后继承遗志，推行佛教社会主义国有化政策，僧伽罗民族主义与少数民族冲突并存。
description_en: Sirimavo Bandaranaike (1916-2000) world first female PM (1960-1965, 1970-1977, 1994-2000), inherited husband legacy after assassination, implemented Buddhist socialism nationalization policies, Sinhala nationalism and minority conflict coexisted.
reason_zh: 班达拉奈克代表女性如何在父权政治中通过丈夫遗志进入权力核心，展示了佛教伦理如何为社会主义提供道德正当性，其三度执政折射斯里兰卡民族主义与民主化的张力。
reason_en: Bandaranaike represents how woman enters power core through husband legacy in patriarchal politics, demonstrating how Buddhist ethics legitimize socialism morally, her three premierships reflecting Sri Lankan nationalism and democratization tension.
steps_zh: 研究班达拉奈克早年贵族家庭与丈夫所罗门政治遗产
分析1960年丈夫遇刺后继任首相创造历史
探讨佛教社会主义国有化茶园与土地改革
评估僧伽罗官方语言法与泰米尔少数民族冲突升级
总结僧伽罗佛教社会主义女性总理对南亚女性政治的破冰意义
steps_en: Study Bandaranaike early aristocratic family and husband Solomon political legacy
Analyze 1960 husband assassination succession PM making history
Explore Buddhist socialism nationalization tea plantations and land reform
Evaluate Sinhala Only Act and Tamil minority conflict escalation
Summarize Sinhala Buddhism socialism woman prime minister breakthrough for South Asian women politics
expected_zh: 理解佛教伦理如何转化为社会主义政策正当性，掌握女性权力在父权政治中的生存策略与代价，评估班达拉奈克对斯里兰卡族群冲突与民主化的复杂遗产。
expected_en: Understand how Buddhist ethics transform into socialism policy legitimacy, grasp woman power survival strategy and cost in patriarchal politics, evaluate Bandaranaike complex legacy for Sri Lankan ethnic conflict and democratization.
case_zh: 1916 出生；1960 首位女总理；1977 失利；1994 复出；2000 逝世。僧伽罗佛教社会主义女性总理范式永存。
case_en: 1916 birth; 1960 first female PM; 1977 defeat; 1994 comeback; 2000 death. Sinhala Buddhism socialism woman prime minister paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: First female PM; Buddhist socialism; Sinhala nationalism; ethnic conflict
gender_role_innovation: 是: 世界首位女总理
